name: Deep Survey

text: The end wall is one chart, nine feet of it, drawn to scale.
A circle laid on a sea floor, and inside the circle, for scale, the subject.
The circle is the smaller of the two shapes.
PROJECT ABYSS CROWN. RESTRAINT ARRAY. CRADLES 1-60.
Sixty stands in two rows and fifty-one of them filled.
Every ring in them was cut out of an Aurelian floor and re-wound by hand.
Nine cradles standing empty at the end of the row, numbered and waiting.
A card gives the date the last nine are due.
It is the end of this month.
A ring kept out of the rack for comparison, split from rim to hub.
Its report card is short and completely honest.
INPUT SUSTAINED 41 SECONDS. SUBJECT RESPONSE: DISTRESS. TERMINATED ON SAFETY.
An Aurelian ring and its rebuild, side by side, so the change is plain.
The old one is tuned to listen and the new one is tuned to insist.
It is the same instrument. It is a completely different sentence.
The bench, and the working sequence chalked on the board above it,
in four words: FIND. WAKE. RING. HOLD.
Under WAKE, smaller: REQUIRES THE HEART. NO SUBSTITUTE FOUND.
A coat over the back of the chair and a cold cup on the bench.
Somebody has been working at this all day and has not gone home,
and there is nothing at all sinister about that, which is the trouble.
A generator, and eleven more like it down the wall.
Sixty rings, sixty generators, and a load sheet that comes to more current
than the city of Aureline draws on a winter night.
Crates stencilled for the coast, waybilled to a harbour with no road to it.
The manifest says SURVEY EQUIPMENT.
The weights on the waybill say sixty of the same thing.
A pallet of coats, boots and cold-weather kit for forty people,
wrapped and dated for the end of the month.
Whatever this is, it is not a plan any more. It is a sailing date.
A console left running, cycling one recorded trace over and over.
It is a pressure reading taken at depth, and it is not weather.
It rises and falls, slowly, evenly, like something enormous breathing.
The floor's own plan, pinned up, with every station numbered.
There is no station on it for the room you came down from
and no stair on it but the one you came down.

_plan: Rebuilt to the ad_contract in data/events/aureline_meridian_deep.json: two long racks of sixty cradles with fifty-one filled, a bench with a coat over the chair, and a nine-foot chart on the end wall of a circle on a sea floor with the subject drawn inside it to scale -- and the subject is the bigger of the two shapes. No Kin, no encounters, no items: a workshop at seven in the evening. The horror is the craftsmanship. Everything here is tidy, honestly reported and well made, including a failure kept for comparison whose own card says the subject was in distress and that they stopped. Then they ordered forty-nine more and a sailing date. ad_kell stands at (26,2), as far from the bench at (10,9) as this floor allows, because the confrontation has her walk the length of it.
